title: Exercise 7: Sentence Combination
instruction: Combine each pair of sentences into a single coherent sentence using the Past Simple and Past Continuous with the provided cue word.

questions.sentence_1: Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was attending to wounded soldiers in the field hospital.
questions.sentence_2: Suddenly, a loud explosion rocked the clinic entrance.
questions.correct_answer: Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was attending to wounded soldiers in the field hospital when a loud explosion rocked the clinic entrance.
acceptable_answers: Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was attending to wounded soldiers in the field hospital when a loud explosion rocked the clinic entrance.
When a loud explosion rocked the clinic entrance, Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was attending to wounded soldiers in the field hospital.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'when' nối hành động ngắn bất ngờ xen vào ('rocked') với hành động dài đang tiếp diễn ('was attending').

questions.sentence_1: Steve Jobs was studying unofficially at Reed College.
questions.sentence_2: He discovered a profound passion for calligraphy and typography.
questions.correct_answer: While Steve Jobs was studying unofficially at Reed College, he discovered a profound passion for calligraphy and typography.
acceptable_answers: While Steve Jobs was studying unofficially at Reed College, he discovered a profound passion for calligraphy and typography.
Steve Jobs discovered a profound passion for calligraphy and typography while he was studying unofficially at Reed College.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'While' mở đầu mệnh đề chỉ quá trình học tập kéo dài, mệnh đề chính dùng Quá khứ đơn 'discovered'.

questions.sentence_1: The animators were drawing character sketches for the new animated film.
questions.sentence_2: At the same time, the sound designers were recording audio effects.
questions.correct_answer: The animators were drawing character sketches for the new animated film while the sound designers were recording audio effects.
acceptable_answers: The animators were drawing character sketches for the new animated film while the sound designers were recording audio effects.
While the animators were drawing character sketches for the new animated film, the sound designers were recording audio effects.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'while' diễn tả hai hành động diễn ra song song cùng lúc trong quá khứ.

questions.sentence_1: General Vo Nguyen Giap was planning the strategic offensive.
questions.sentence_2: His military couriers brought vital intelligence from the northern front.
questions.correct_answer: While General Vo Nguyen Giap was planning the strategic offensive, his military couriers brought vital intelligence from the northern front.
acceptable_answers: While General Vo Nguyen Giap was planning the strategic offensive, his military couriers brought vital intelligence from the northern front.
General Vo Nguyen Giap's military couriers brought vital intelligence from the northern front while he was planning the strategic offensive.
questions.explanation: Hành động người liên lạc mang tin mật tới ('brought') xảy ra cắt ngang quá trình lập kế hoạch ('was planning').

questions.sentence_1: The volunteers were distributing emergency rations to the flood victims.
questions.sentence_2: An unexpected downpour caused river levels to rise rapidly.
questions.correct_answer: The volunteers were distributing emergency rations to the flood victims when an unexpected downpour caused river levels to rise rapidly.
acceptable_answers: The volunteers were distributing emergency rations to the flood victims when an unexpected downpour caused river levels to rise rapidly.
When an unexpected downpour caused river levels to rise rapidly, the volunteers were distributing emergency rations to the flood victims.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'when' cho mệnh đề Quá khứ đơn diễn tả sự việc đột ngột xảy đến.

questions.sentence_1: The young biologist was conducting research in the pristine rainforest.
questions.sentence_2: She discovered an unrecorded species of medicinal flora.
questions.correct_answer: While the young biologist was conducting research in the pristine rainforest, she discovered an unrecorded species of medicinal flora.
acceptable_answers: While the young biologist was conducting research in the pristine rainforest, she discovered an unrecorded species of medicinal flora.
The young biologist discovered an unrecorded species of medicinal flora while she was conducting research in the pristine rainforest.
questions.explanation: Hành động phát hiện loài cây mới ('discovered') xảy ra trong quá trình nghiên cứu ('was conducting').

questions.sentence_1: The film director was filming the climactic battle scene.
questions.sentence_2: The heavy camera crane suffered a severe mechanical failure.
questions.correct_answer: The heavy camera crane suffered a severe mechanical failure while the film director was filming the climactic battle scene.
acceptable_answers: The heavy camera crane suffered a severe mechanical failure while the film director was filming the climactic battle scene.
While the film director was filming the climactic battle scene, the heavy camera crane suffered a severe mechanical failure.
questions.explanation: Sự cố cơ học ('suffered') diễn ra trong lúc đoàn phim đang quay đại cảnh chiến đấu ('was filming').

questions.sentence_1: The software engineer was demonstrating the cutting-edge AI model.
questions.sentence_2: The conference hall lost its internet connection completely.
questions.correct_answer: The software engineer was demonstrating the cutting-edge AI model when the conference hall lost its internet connection completely.
acceptable_answers: The software engineer was demonstrating the cutting-edge AI model when the conference hall lost its internet connection completely.
When the conference hall lost its internet connection completely, the software engineer was demonstrating the cutting-edge AI model.
questions.explanation: Mất kết nối mạng là sự cố xen vào quá trình kỹ sư đang thuyết trình giới thiệu mô hình.

questions.sentence_1: The couple were preparing for their wedding ceremony.
questions.sentence_2: They received congratulatory letters from their former professors.
questions.correct_answer: While the couple were preparing for their wedding ceremony, they received congratulatory letters from their former professors.
acceptable_answers: While the couple were preparing for their wedding ceremony, they received congratulatory letters from their former professors.
The couple received congratulatory letters from their former professors while they were preparing for their wedding ceremony.
questions.explanation: Hành động nhận thư chúc mừng xảy đến trong quá trình chuẩn bị hôn lễ.

questions.sentence_1: The historian was compiling biographical accounts of ancient queens.
questions.sentence_2: He uncovered rare royal manuscripts preserved in the temple archives.
questions.correct_answer: While the historian was compiling biographical accounts of ancient queens, he uncovered rare royal manuscripts preserved in the temple archives.
acceptable_answers: While the historian was compiling biographical accounts of ancient queens, he uncovered rare royal manuscripts preserved in the temple archives.
The historian uncovered rare royal manuscripts preserved in the temple archives while he was compiling biographical accounts of ancient queens.
questions.explanation: Quá trình biên soạn tài liệu là hành động nền kéo dài dùng Quá khứ tiếp diễn sau 'While'.
